title: Console live mode badge + toggle control (loop vs harness)
description: BETA-TEST GOAL (goal-mode-switch), part 2 of 2. Make the operating mode (from TASK-063) VISIBLE and controllable in the web console: a live badge in the status bar showing HARNESS vs LOOP with distinct styling, updating in real time as the mode flips (e.g. when the autonomous loop starts/stops), plus a manual toggle control (button) in the console that flips the mode. Extends the v0.5.0 console status bar (src/task-board.js + src/session-projection.js + the inline status-bar HTML). Built on the `beta` branch; depends on TASK-063. This is the human-observable payoff of the beta test — the deliverable you watch while the loop drives.
acceptance_criteria: The console status bar renders a mode badge showing HARNESS or LOOP (from GET /api/session's `mode`), with visually distinct styling per mode, XSS-safe (createElement/textContent per the existing board rendering discipline).
The badge updates LIVE (via the existing session polling/refresh mechanism) so flipping the mode — manually or by the loop auto-flip — is reflected without a page reload.

A manual toggle control (button) in the console flips the mode: a new hardened POST route (e.g. POST /api/session/mode behind the existing Host allowlist + Content-Type/body-cap guards) calls setMode (TASK-063); the badge reflects the change live.
Graceful when `mode` is absent (older bundle) — badge defaults to HARNESS, no crash.

tests-after: implement, prove by running (badge renders + toggle endpoint flips mode + projection reflects it), then add minimal regression locks (route behavior + projection field + render presence). New e2e (server/route) under tests/e2e/.

UAT (human-observable, dogfood payoff): launch the console, see the mode badge; click the toggle and watch it flip; start /hivemind-beta:loop and watch the badge auto-flip to LOOP, then back to HARNESS when the loop halts/exits.
Rebuild dist (task-board bundle) via npm run build:plugin and commit; npm run test:all green.

comments.author: uat
comments.body:
UAT — TASK-064 console mode badge + toggle (human, live browser, 2026-06-17). Dogfood payoff of goal-mode-switch.
Step 1 (AC1): launch console, see mode badge. Expected: badge reads HARNESS, distinct styling. Observed: HARNESS shown, distinct styling. PASS.
Step 2 (AC2 manual/AC3): click toggle. Expected: badge flips HARNESS->LOOP live, no reload. Observed: flipped live. PASS.
Step 3 (AC2/AC3): click toggle again. Expected: badge flips LOOP->HARNESS live. Observed: flipped live. PASS.
Step 4 (AC2 auto-flip/AC6): orchestrator setMode(loop) out-of-band, no chat turn/reload. Expected: badge auto-updates to LOOP without reload. FIRST ATTEMPT FAILED (stayed HARNESS until reload) -> sent back to developer, fix 0b1888b added a 4s /api/session poll -> RE-TESTED: badge flipped to LOOP on its own within ~4s, no reload. PASS (after fix).
Step 5 (AC4 graceful-absent): older bundle without mode -> badge defaults HARNESS, no crash. PASS — verified by Orchestrator at the human request (covered by regression locks + dev legacy-bundle proof).
OVERALL: PASS. All ACs covered; the one initial FAIL (step 4) drove a REQUEST-CHANGES fix that now passes.
